title: Gradient
author: @lunokjod
description:
The sixteen levels of this glass, drawn as a test card: sixteen labelled steps, a smooth ramp across the width and down the height, five big patches and two halves. A page at a time, with the ink it is painted in named on the bar — `gc16`, `gl16` and `du` — so the same picture can be compared in the three waveforms a panel can have.
It is the page a person opens when the greys do not look right: counting the steps that can be told apart is the measurement, and the number of the level is written inside its own bar.
